pamphlet_excerpts: Horsemanship Sub-Req 1a: Describe the safety precautions you should take when handling and caring for a horse.
Horsemanship Sub-Req 1b: Describe the fire safety precautions you should take in a barn and around horses.
Core Standard 1 (Req 1): Do the following: (a) Describe the safety precautions you should take when handling and caring for a horse.
Core Standard 2 (Req 1): (b) Describe the fire safety precautions you should take in a barn and around horses.
step_by_step_procedure: Prepare & Inspect (Req 1): Review the official Horsemanship requirement standard and verify all required tools, reference tables, and safety gear.
Analyze Core Principles: Identify the primary concepts, definitions, and cause-and-effect relationships governing (a) Describe the safety precautions you should take.
Execute & Document: Perform the demonstrate task methodically with your patrol buddy and log specific observations in your Horsemanship Workbook.
Verify With Counselor: Present your completed work, demonstrate proficiency, and answer Socratic check-for-understanding questions for Blue Card sign-off.

requirements.req_text: Do ONE of the following: (a) Explore careers related to this merit badge. Research one career to learn about the training and education needed, costs, job prospects, salary, job duties, and career advancement. Your research methods may include—with your parent or guardian's permission—an internet or library search, an interview with a professional in the field, or a visit to a location where people in this career work. Discuss with your counselor both your findings and what about this profession might make it an interesting career. (b) Explore how you could use knowledge and skills from this merit badge to pursue a hobby or healthy lifestyle. Research any training needed, expenses, and organizations that promote or support it. Discuss with your counselor what short-term and long-term goals you might have if you pursued this.
